# SOP-P1-L1-03 First-article inspection - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03  
Related documents: MM-P1-L1-RR01, SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-05

Purpose
1. Define the standard operating procedure for first-article inspection on the Hot Forge line to verify conformance of initial production parts before release to process flow.

Scope
2. Applies to first-article parts produced on the Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill, CNC turning center, and induction heater at plant P1, line P1-L1. Affected equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03.

Preconditions
3. The production order and drawing package must be available and approved per SOP-P1-L1-01.  
4. Maintenance and calibration records for measurement instruments must be current and available; refer to MM-P1-L1-RR01 for rolling mill maintenance criteria and calibration linkage.  
5. The machine status must be verified against the machine master tag and cleared for trial run by the equipment owner listed in SOP-P1-L1-05.

PPE
6. Required personal protective equipment for first-article inspection activities on the Hot Forge line: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, hearing protection, and protective footwear. Ensure PPE is inspected prior to entry.

Background and rationale
7. First-article inspection validates that process settings, tooling, and material handling produce parts that meet drawing requirements before full production. EQ-P1-L1-RR01 and EQ-P1-L1-CN02 are critical process steps; issues in these machines propagate defects downstream. The inspection captures setup defects, tooling errors, and handling impacts, reducing scrap and rework.

Key inspection criteria
8. Maximum ring outer diameter is a critical dimensional requirement for rings produced on EQ-P1-L1-RR01. The maximum ring outer diameter for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 1240 mm. Confirm ring outer diameter does not exceed this value per drawing tolerance control.  
9. Chuck jaw mounting and retention integrity on EQ-P1-L1-CN02 are critical to operator safety and part accuracy. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 100 N·m. Verify bolts are torqued to this value during first-article setup and after any jaw change.

Procedure (numbered steps)
10. Preparation
   10.1. Verify production drawing and first-article checklist are present and reference SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 for drawing release and process change control.  
   10.2. Confirm material lot and heat treatment traceability are attached to the first-article record.  
   10.3. Confirm calibration stickers on measuring instruments and gauges are current.

11. Machine setup verification
   11.1. For EQ-P1-L1-RR01, confirm tooling and backup rolls are installed per setup sheets and that rolling path is clear of debris. Refer to MM-P1-L1-RR01 for maintenance-derived setup requirements.  
   11.2. For EQ-P1-L1-CN02, install the chuck jaws and bring bolts to specification. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 100 N·m; record the torque application event in the setup log.  
   11.3. For EQ-P1-L1-IH03, confirm induction coil alignment and thermal barrier placement per SOP-P1-L1-05.

12. Trial run and sample extraction
   12.1. Execute a controlled single-piece run through EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-IH03, and EQ-P1-L1-CN02. Monitor for abnormal vibration, sound, or handling issues.  
   12.2. Extract the first-article part at the inspection station using designated handling tools and PPE.

13. Dimensional inspection
   13.1. Measure the ring outer diameter first; confirm the part’s outer diameter is at or below the maximum ring outer diameter for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) which is 1240 mm. Record the measured value and inspector initials on the first-article form.  
   13.2. Complete all critical dimension checks referenced on the drawing and checklist. Note any deviations and whether they are process-related or measurement artifacts.

14. Functional and visual inspection
   14.1. Conduct visual inspection for surface defects introduced during rolling, heating, or turning. Document the type and location of any feature outside acceptable cosmetic standards.  
   14.2. Verify concentricity and runout where called out on the drawing using calibrated instruments; document instrument ID and calibration status.

15. Nonconformance handling
   15.1. If any critical dimension or safety item is out of tolerance, stop production and notify the process engineer per SOP-P1-L1-01. Tag the part and area to prevent inadvertent use.  
   15.2. Capture root cause and corrective action; update the first-article record and attach to the production order.

Records to keep
16. Maintain the following records in the document control system attached to the production order: first-article inspection form, instrument calibration certificates, torque application log showing the chuck jaw bolt torque for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 100 N·m, photographs of the first-article part, and the dimensional measurement sheet confirming the maximum ring outer diameter for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 1240 mm threshold status. Link maintenance verification to MM-P1-L1-RR01 where applicable.

Examples and notes
17. Example entry: inspector records measured outer diameter and notes “outer diameter 1238 mm — within limit 1240 mm” then initials and timestamps the form. Use this style for clarity and traceability. (Note: examples should be accompanied by actual measured values from the inspection event.)

Rationale for key checks
18. Verifying the chuck jaw bolt torque to the specified value prevents chuck slippage and enhances concentricity, reducing scrap and safety risk. Confirming the ring outer diameter against the specified maximum prevents downstream interference and handling issues.

PPE and safety reminders
19. Ensure PPE is worn during all handling and inspection steps. Do not remove hot parts from the line without heat-rated gloves and handling tools. Follow lockout-tagout procedures per SOP-P1-L1-05 for any machine intervention.

Sign-off
20. Completion and acceptance of the first-article requires signatures from the following roles recorded on the first-article form: inspector, process engineer, and production supervisor. Each signatory must reference related documents MM-P1-L1-RR01, SOP-P1-L1-01, and SOP-P1-L1-05 as part of their acceptance review.

Revision control
21. Maintain this SOP in the document control system and reference the file by id SOP-P1-L1-03. Any changes to the critical values specified herein must be approved through the revision process cited in SOP-P1-L1-01.
